purpose: Independent postprocessing of the frozen ordinary-dip feature experiment. No model fits, threshold searches, output-driven protocol changes, or production writes.
audit_steps: Verify frozen input/source/panel provenance checksums, evaluation-sidecar baseline binding, and identical unique date/ticker populations including MRCY.
For each available model result verify numeric score checksums, schema, exact chronological training/scoring row identity, round count and parameters; rebuild daily selections independently.
Reconcile stored daily Rank IC, top5/top20/gated returns, trade/cash counts and0/10/25/50bps cost summaries.

For Fit only, compute stock-day-weighted mean absolute prediction error from cached predictions and every matched frozen label, including unselected stocks. Report candidate-minus-baseline MAE; never apply this metric to Rank scores.
Recompute week-cluster paired intervals independently and verify stored values. Freeze choice remains inner-only; independently reproduce that choice without outer reselection.
Check compact uses only positive gains from its matching training-window all-input model. Report every feature training gain, normalized gain fraction, nonmissing coverage and distinct-value counts.

After selecting stocks from cached scores, join realized Low/High sidecar and summarize constituent adverse/favorable excursions and MRCY selections; no future outcome becomes an input or selection criterion.
Report descriptive ticker contribution concentration and extreme selected-stock returns, without new filters or threshold searches.
Audit available42 SVM source checkpoints and their132/153 schemas, chronology, hashes, row counts and recorded convergence warnings.
Pool only complete predeclared outer blocks. Mark incomplete Fit evidence explicitly; final command fails when any expected model or SVM output is missing.

Carry forward the independently reviewed SPCX identity discontinuity, unresolved QH price-basis issue, confirmed ordinary volume anomalies, and recorded ordinary19-versus-frozen21 schema distinction. Preserve convergence warnings at unchanged iteration limits.
interpretation_rules: Return numbers are fractions: multiply by100 for percentage points,10000 for basis points.
Round-trip cost applies to invested capital on active equal-weight days; cash days have zero return and zero cost.
Constituent Low/Open summaries are not simultaneous portfolio intraday drawdown and cannot justify a realizable stop/exit backtest.
Pointwise exploratory confidence intervals are not multiplicity-corrected confirmation of a predictive bottom.
Inner improvement is selection evidence. Do not select a new winner or tighten features using these outer outcomes.
Zero feature gain is evidence of non-use in that fitted head, not alone a reason to delete an ordinary feature. Keep pruning recommendations cautious and use the existing normal pruning process.
One full Fit outer block supports a narrower conclusion than three Rank blocks. Rank refinements have no full-Fit confirmation in this iteration.

Fit MAE is prediction error in return-fraction units over all scored stock-days, with lower values better. It has no selection/gate filter and is not equal-date-weighted. Rank scores are not in return units and have no MAE diagnostic.
initial_validation: Five independent small tests pass, including analytical Fit-only MAE and rejection of misaligned vectors.45 actual Rank results were previously audited; both Fit heads remain pending.
implementation_scope: Only research/postprocessing files created; hash-frozen feature/training source remains unchanged.
